nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Template for the production server .env: Postgres credentials, auth and revalidation secrets, site domain, S3 buckets, SMTP, VAPID, Colissimo, Meta/WhatsApp tokens and Sentry.

nodes.name: backup.sh
nodes.summary: Hourly backup script that pg_dumps the production database, uploads it to the S3 backup bucket via rclone, prunes local dumps and reports a CloudWatch metric for the missing-backup alarm.

nodes.name: deploy.sh
nodes.summary: Zero-downtime API deploy script: backs up, runs pending migrations, starts the new API container beside the old one, waits for health, then retires the old container or rolls back.
nodes.languageNotes: POSIX sh with set -eu; uses docker compose --scale and --no-recreate to run old and new containers side by side behind Caddy.

nodes.name: docker-compose.prod.yml
nodes.summary: Production compose stack on the EC2 server: Postgres 17 (loopback-only), the NestJS API image with a health check, and Caddy as HTTPS reverse proxy load-balancing across API containers.
